name: Green
author: Addicting Games
description: Green is a free puzzle game. The color of money, the color of greed, the color of spinach, and the color of lime: Green is here, it is time to play. Some people say it isn't easy being green, they're actually wrong. It's quite easy to be green, but green as a game, a construct? That is where things get dicey, that is where they get complicated, that is where they get fun. Green is another game in a series of puzzle games from Bart Bonte. In this game, there isn't a specific series of puzzles that test your mental capacity. In these games, you don't even know what the puzzle is until you start clicking around. Every level is different and every level will drain you of your valuble energy as you try to figure out what the deal is and how to overcome it. This is a fun puzzle game for people who like to crack the case as well as click on through to the other side. If you think you're smart enough to win then prove it with Green, the game.
